title: Harry Potter And The Cursed Child - review
transcript: I've read the Harry Potter books and seen most of the films JK Rowling tells a good children's story that adults can also enjoy and she does it again with this stage play Harry Potter and the cursed charter if you don't know about Harry Potter you might be less intrigued than I was by this return to Hogwarts past and present Rowling's saga of good versus evil in the world of witchcraft continues with the Sons of Harry and his former enemy Draco Malfoy both boys suffer from being the children of well known parents and that's why they become friends and go on an adventure together in a venture which is as much about the excitement of problem-solving as fighting evil the cursed child is blessed with a script by Jack form which is full of humor and some emotional depth especially in the exploration of the difficult relationship between the adult Harry and his adolescent son both troubled by the past there are some very good characters I especially like the Malfoy's played with relish when I saw the plays by James Howard and young Samuel Blanc in John Tiffany's production has some excellent theatrical effects with allusions by Jamie Harrison that provides some real wow moments the difficulty for me is that while action adventures told on stage work for children for adults they can seem a little melodramatic I give Harry Potter and the cursed child for stars and who exactly is the cursed child well the answer is you
reasoning: Four-star rating with praise for script, characters, and theatrical effects, though tempered by the caveat that adult viewers may find the action-adventure melodramatic.
